title: Secret Management
summary: Secrets never belong in Git, URLs, or client-delivered JavaScript.
objectives: Explain Secret Management in practical web-development terms
Recognize how Web Essentials connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.md: Rotate keys immediately if exposed in logs or repos.

quickRecap: Practice with the quiz — execution on device is limited to HTML/CSS/JS in the playground.

exercise.prompt: Review the example, then open the playground only when the lesson uses HTML/CSS/JS starter code. Complete the quiz to earn XP.
